scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,dashboard -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/dashboard && npm run build -w apps/rider
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/dashboard && npm run lint -w apps/rider
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, NODE_ENV: 'test', REDIS_IN_MEMORY: 'true', NOTIFICATION_OUTBOX_INLINE: 'true', MQTT_DISABLED: 'true' }; const result = spawnSync('npm', ['run', 'test:e2e', '-w', 'apps/api', '--', '--runInBand', '--testTimeout=30000'], { stdio: 'inherit', env, shell: true }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
